subject: [hw] V03→V02: unresolved-import contract + n2a32_mem questions
body: I implement include/n2elf.h n2elf_link. Need to agree on the unresolved-import mechanism now (n2elf.h: "unresolved functions -> the unresolved slot + count", "run stops with N2A32_STOP_NOIMPORT and the symbol name"; "Slot 0 is reserved for unresolved"). My proposal: the loader calls n2a32_hostcall_register(fn=one shared n2elf_unresolved_cb, name="<sym>") for EACH unresolved symbol name, so each name gets its own slot address; the callback sets c->stop = N2A32_STOP_NOIMPORT and c->stop_request = 1 (and returns), and the core reports n2a32_hostcall_name(pc/slot) as the name. a) Does your core support distinct slots for the same fn pointer with different names (i.e. dedupe key = fn+name)? b) Will you check the hostcall target slot == 0 before/after the callback to set STOP_NOIMPORT and keep the name, or should my callback set c->stop? c) If you prefer slot 0 only: how do I attach the symbol name so your core prints it? Please answer with the exact contract you implement; I will match it. Also: does n2a32_mem_alloc() return zeroed pages already mapped writable (so I can memcpy segments and later n2a32_mem_protect text RO), and is n2a32_mem_protect(addr,len,writable) page-aligned-range only? And when do you expect emu/*.c to be usable so I can drop my test stand-in?
